CustomField.formula:
text( Start_Date__c) & " " &
Case(WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c), 1,'Sunday', 2,'Monday', 3,'Tuesday', 4,'Wednesday', 5,'Thursday', 6,'Friday', 7,'Saturday', "")
& ", " & text(Group_Class_Name__c) & ", " & "Time: " & text(Time__c) & ", " & "Location: " & text(Location__c)
CustomField.label: Group / Class Summary
